text.body:
p. 1a) oṃ namaḥ kālikāyai ||
asya śrīmahāguhye kālisvalpaṣoḍhānyāsavidyā ānandabhairava ṛṣirūṣnicchandaḥ śrīmanmahāguhye kālīkādeśinī siddhidā śaktiḥ śrīmahāprakaṭakālikādevatā devatā hūṁ vījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ śeṣaṃ kilākaṃ mama śarīraśuddhiḥ pūrvakadṛḍhatvaprāptaye viniyogaḥ || vaddhāṃjaliḥ ||
hāṁ hīṁ hūṁ haiṁ hauṁ haḥ || karāṃganyāsaḥ | dhyānaṃ || prakaṭāṃ śūlataṃkādhaḥ pānapātraṃ śivānvitāṃ |
p. 1b) varābhayakarāṃ bhīmāṃ pūrvavat sarvaṃ saṃyutāṃ || evaṃ dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya | daśadhā japaṃ vaddhāṃjaliḥ prakaṭe kālike devi mantrasiddhipradāyinī silpaṣoḍhāṃ kariṣyāmi dṛḍhīkuru vapurmama || atha nyāsaḥ phreṁ hrīṁ chīṁ strīṁ hūṁ hūṁ saḥ svāhā prakaṭakālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || ādhāre oṃ ghorakālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || liṃge || oṃ draṃṣṭrinī kālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || p. 2a) nābhau || oṃ ghorakālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || hṛdaye oṃ aṭṭāṭṭahāsakālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || kaṇṭhe || oṃ śiromālinīkālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || bhrūmadhye || meghaprabhākālikāyai namaḥ svāhā | vrahamraṃdhye || oṃ kharvakālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || lālāṭe || oṃ jayapradākālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || mūkhe || oṃ sṛṣṭikālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || mūlādivāmahastāntaṃ || p. 2b) oṃ sthitikālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || mūlādidakṣahastāntaṃ || oṃ saṃhārakālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || vrahmaraṃdhodīkaṇṭhāntaṃ || oṃ bhāsākālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || kaṇṭhādihṛdayāntaṃ || oṃ nākṣākālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || hṛdayānābhyantaṃ || āmnāyasārakālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || nābhyādivāmapākāntaṃ || oṃ kaurasākālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || nābhyāṃdidakṣa pādāntaṃ || p. 3a) oṃ rahasyasārakālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || vrahmaraṃdhodiguhyānta pṛṣṭataḥ || oṃ yoginīsārakālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || guḍadigulphāntaṃ pṛṣṭataḥ || sarvaśaktisārakālikāyai namaḥ svāhā || śrīmanmahāprakaṭakālikāyai hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā || śirādipādāntatridhā vyāpakaṃ hūṁ lelihānāmudrāṃ darśayen praṇamet || vaddhāṃjaliḥ || sarvaśuddhiprade devi prakaṭe vrahmarūpiṇi || p. 3b) dehaśuddhiṃ prayachādya kālikāmarcayāmyahaṃ || iti svalpaṣoḍhānyāsaḥ ||
namaḥ śrīkālikāyai || bhairavyuvāca ||
bhagavan śrotumichāmi mānavekena hetunā || mantrāḥ parāṅmukhāyānti koṭijaptā api prabho ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
etadrahasyaṃ kathayāmi tvayi priye || śopitavyaṃ prayatnena svayonimiva vallabhe || kavacena vināyastu kālīmantrajapodyataḥ || sanasiddhimavāpnoti koṭikalpaśatairapi || p. 4a) kavacaṃ paṃcakaṃ jñeyaṃ prathamaṃ deharakṣakaṃ | dvitīyaṃ nāma saṃśuptaṃ tṛtīyaṃ śastabhūṣitaṃ || caturthaṃ vījaśaktyādi bhūṣitaṃ paṃcamaṃ śṛṇū | mantrabhūtaṃ varārohe bhuvi sarvārthasādhanaṃ || asya deharakṣakaṃ kavacasya kālāgnirudra ṛṣiranuṣṭup cchandaḥ śrīmahāguhyakālī devatā phraṃ vījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ śeṣakīlakaṃ mama deharakṣaṇe viniyogaḥ || iti vaddhāṃjalidevīṃ manasādhyātvā paṭhed ||
p. 4b) pheṁ śiro me kālikā pātu bhālaṃ guhye svarūpiṇī || prakaṭākhyā dṛśyai pātu vikaṭākhyā mama śruti || draṃṣṭinī nāśike pāyāntu khaṃme ghora rūpiṇī || aṭṭāṭṭahāso rasanaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ me muṇḍamālinī || skaṃdhau meghaprabhā pātu bhujau me kharvakālikā || jayapradā karau pātu hṛdayaṃ caṇḍaghaṇṭikā || vakṣaḥ kuleśvarī pātu hastaṃśakti priyā mama || pārśvau me jaṭinī pāyād yoginī cakracāriṇī || p. 5a) lalajjihvā pātu kukṣiṃ madhyaṃ dānavaghāṭinī || nābhiṃ ghoramukhī pāyāt nacarmadhāriṇī jaṭī || māṃsabhakṣyā śaktinī meḍaruśoṇitabhojinī || khecarī jānunī pātu jaṃgha kharparadhāriṇī || pādau sarvatra gopāyāt sarvāṅgaṃ kālikā svāhā || iti te kathitaṃ devi kavacaṃ deharakṣakaṃ || vinānena siddhiḥ syāt kalpakoṭiśatairapi || gurubhaktimate deyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || p. 5b) śāntāya śuddhacintāya devībhaktāya cāriṇe | paṭhitvā kavacaṃ devī japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥ || urjaṭe parvate vāpi śmaśāne vā yathā ruciḥ || vighnāntasya saṃbhavaṃti naiva kutrāpi śobhane || puraścaryādikaṃ sarvaṃ mūlavabhparivālayet ||
iti yoginīhṛdaye guhyekālīrahasya devasya deharakṣakakavacannāma stotraṃ samāptaṃ |
atha cakra nyāsaḥ asya sarvasiddhivaktranyāsasya bhairava ṛṣiranuṣṭupchandaḥ sarvbhakṣā devatā phreṁ vījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ śeṣaṃ kīlakaṃ mama vākśuddhiprāptaye mithyādoṣapraśamane viniyogaḥ || p. 6a) iti vaddhāṃjaliḥ ||
athanyāsaḥ || phreṁ hrīṁ cchrīṁ strīṁ hūṁ phreṁ saḥ svāhā nijamūlatamo guṇādhiṣṭita mūlavaktrāya svāhā || iti mukhe || phreṁ hrīṁ cchrīṁ strīṁ hūṁ saḥ svāhā nijamūlarajoguṇādhiṣṭhitapārśvavaktrāya svāhā || mark ji chek$$$$$p. 6b) vāmabhāge || phreṁ hrīṁ cchrīṁ strīṁ hūṁ saḥ svāhā nijamūlasatvaguṇādhiṣṭhitapārśvavaktrāya svāhā || dakṣabhāge || phreṁ hrīṁ cchrīṁ hūṁ saḥ svāhā nijamūlatriguṇādhiṣṭitatrivaktrāyai hūṁ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā || sarvatra maṇḍalākāreṇa || iti vaktranyāsaḥ ||
asyā śrīguhyakālī sāvitrī vidyāyā vrahmā ṛṣigāyatrī cchandaḥ pavitrādhāni sā vitri gāyatrī kālikā devatā phreṁ vījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ śeṣaṃ kīlakaṃ mama pavitra śodhane viniyogaḥ || p. 7a) iti vaddhāṃjaliḥ || phreṁ prakaṭa sāvitryai vighnahevika gāyatryai dhīmahītantraḥ kālī pracodayāt svāhā || iti pavitrābhi mantraṇaṃ || atha pādakara śodhanaṃ || rahuḥ iti caraṇahastau prakṣālpātaḥ dhhrī iti prokṣye candanena krīṃ iti hastapādataleṣu vilikhyate naiva vījena tridhābhimaṃtryātaḥ te naiva vījena tridhābhimaṃtrya jalaṃtajjalena śarīraṃ siṃcayediti śmaśāna kālī sādhanaka paricāraka śarīrasiddhiḥ || p. 7b) asya śrīmahākālī vidyāyāmahā śmaśāna bhairava ṛṣistrī ūcchandaḥ śrīmanmahāguhyakālī kalālī devatācchraṃ vījaṃcchraḥ śaktiḥ śeṣaṃ kīlakaṃ mama sarva siddhyarthe viniyogaḥ || iti vaddhāṃjaliḥ paṭhitvā śirasi || śrīmahāśmaśāna bhairavāaya namaḥ || mukheḥ triṣṭracchandase nayaḥ nābhau ccheṁ vījāya namaḥ || p. 8a) mūlādhāne || cchaḥ śaktaye namaḥ || pādayoḥ || śeṣaṃ kīlakāya namaḥ || śirādipādāṃtaṃ || mama sarva siddhyarthe viniyogaḥ || iti tryaṣyādi nyāsaḥ || cchrāṃ aṃguṣṭābhyāṃ namaḥ || cchrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || cchruṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ || cchraiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ || cchrauṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || cchraḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭābhyāṃ namaḥ || cchrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ || cchrīṃ śirase svāhā || cchūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || cchraṃ kavacāya hūṃ || p. 8b) cchrauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | cchraḥ astāya phaṭ dhyāyet || śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi karālī dhyāna mūntamaṃ || trivaktrāṃ śyāmapītāccha rūpāṃ tu raṃganāgabhāṃ || mahāmuṇḍaṃ mudgalacchapānapātradharāṃ tataḥ || mūdrāṃ kuśaṃ triśūlaṃ ca dhāriṇī muṇḍamālinīṃ || naracarmaparīdhānāṃ nāgāraṃ śyāmalāṃ jaṭilāṃ lola || jihvāṃ draṣṭrabhayaṃkarāṃ || bhairavena samāśliṣṭāṃ pūrvavat sthāna bhūṣitāṃ || p. 9a) evaṃ dhyātvā mūlamantreṇa pūṣpāṃjali trayaṃ datvā || yathāśaktijaptvā japaṃ samarpa || valiṃ dadyāt || mūlamantra śrīmahāguhye kālī karālikālike imaṃvaliṃ gṛhna 2 mama sarvaśāntiṃ duru 2 hūṁ phaṭ svā || tato vaddhāṃ jaliḥ || praśamet kālike varadedevī karālikala nātmike || yathāśaktikṛtā pūjā sarvasiddhiṃ prayacchame || asya śrī jvālā prajvali mahā śmaśāna p. 9b) guhye kālī mantrasya mahāpralaya kālāgni rudra ṛṣircilāṭ cchando mahā śmaśāna jvālā guhyakālī devatā śrīṁ vījaṃ hrīṁ śaktiḥ klīṃ kīlakaṃ hūṁ kavacaṃ phreṁ tatvaṃ mamacaturvarga phalasiddhyarthe japa hrīṁ śrīṁ klīṁ hūṁ phreṁ jvārājvarita locani mahā śmaśān guhyekālike aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || mahāmuṇḍamālini 10 || 5 rjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || 5 mahākavandhamālā bhīṣaṇi || p. 10a) 10 madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ || 5 jvārā jvaridraṣṭini 10 anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ || 5 mahāvikaṭahāsya bhayaṃkari 10 kaniṣṭikābhyāṃ namaḥ || 5 vidyujjihvā prajvalita lālavahni jihve 10 karatalakarapṛṣṭābhyāṃ namaḥ || 5 mahākrodhamukhi 10 hṛdayāya namaḥ || 5 śatrujihvāstaṃbhini 10 śirase svāhā || 5 daityadānava śoṇitāśana priye 10 śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || 5 madhupānamanttaduprekṣa jvārāmukhi 10 kavacāya hūṃ || p. 10b) duṣṭa hṛdaye māṃsa mālini 10 netratrayāya vauṣaṭ || 5 cintitamanoratha sādhaki sarvalokabhayaṃkari || vrahmaviṣṇudrudrādi pūjita caraṇojvārā jvarita mahāśmaśāna guhye kālike hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā astāya phaṭ || dhyānaṃ || ghorāṭṭahāsa duḥprekṣāṃ ghorajihvāti bhīṣaṇīṃ || jvālā vikaṭa duṣṭābhyāṃ vairī mastaka bhidini || jvālāni nāda duḥprekṣāṃ jvālā jvalita locanāṃ || p. 11a) mahāmuṇḍa mahāmālāṃ mahāpreta lalāṭike || vāmapāda samārūḍhāṃ tatpāda yugalepi ca || śiṃjantū purapādena savyana mahatāpi ca || samākrāntāṃ mahāghaurāṃ vrahmāṇḍā vṛta || kāṃcī valayaśobhādyā sarpakaṃcūka bhīṣaṇāṃ || bhasma saṃcchatra sarvāghnaṃ tripurāṅkita lalāṭikāṃ || jaṭāmukuṭa śobhādyāṃ candrārddha kṛtaśekharāṃ || yugāntāgni mahāghorāṃ vamantī mukhagahvarāt || p. 11b) hālāhalaviṣaṃ caiva muñcantī daśadikṣu ca || svapādapadma bhajatāṃ daityadāna varakṣasāṃ || vrahmādīnāṃ nṛṇāṃ caiva caturvarga phalapradāṃ || jvālāvalibhirāśliṣṭāṃ mahāvahūrbhayaṃkaraṃ || vilphuliṃga mahādhārāṃvamantaṃmada garvitaṃ || jvalacchūlaṃ mahākhaḍgaṃ duṣṭāntaṃ lokabhīṣaṇaṃ || aṭṭahāsa durārādhyāṃ mahāmuṇḍa mahādbhutāṃ || jvaratsudhā mahāpātraṃ vibhrāṇāṃ karapaṃkajaiḥ || bhūtapreta piśācādyai yakṣagaṃdharva rākṣasaiḥ || p. 12a) mṛddaṃgaśaṃkhabheryādyaiḥ sevitāṃ ghrisaroruhāṃ || madhū gaṃdha mukhāṃ bhojāṃ madhumāṃsādi bhachiṇī || matsyaraktasya valibhiḥ śatrumastaka bhakṣaṇīṃ || nīlamegha ghanaśyāmāṃ māhāniṣṭura karmiṇīṃ || māhāmāyāṃ māhākālīṃ guhyakālīṃ kumārikāṃ || muktavastrāṃ muktakeśī pīnottata mahāstanīṃ || mahāśmaśāna madhyaṣṭāṃ bhūtapretādi saṃkulāṃ || kāla saṃkarṣaṇī devī kālarātri svarūpiṇī || p. 12b) mātaraṃjagatāṃ sākṣādvandehaṃ yonimudrayā || athapaṃcopacāra pūjā || hrīṁ hūṁ phreṁ jvalatpāvaka locani jvara 2 sugaṃdhamālāmālini guhyakālike gaṃdhaṃ samarpayāmi || gaṃdhasya || hrīṁ hūṁ phreṁ ugra jvālā kālike prajvala 2 pālijāta puṣpamālaṃkṛta śarīrīni guhyakāli puṣpaṃ namaḥ tarpayāmi || puṣpasya || hrīṁ hūṁ phreṁ dhūpajvālā prajvalita mahāśmaśāna vāsinigarja 2 candanā gurukarpūra kastūrī gorocanāadi jvārāmālā prajvarita mahādhūpadhūpita śarīriṇī guhyakāli dhūpaṃ samarpayāmi || p. 13a) dhūpasya || hrīṁ hūṁ phreṁ divyā mṛta kardamabhūṃṣita karpūravat paripita pralayāgni jvālā dīpi maṇḍita mahāmandira bhayaṅkarinarta 2 guhyakālike dīpaṃ samarpayāmi || dīpasya hrīṁ hūṁ phreṁ madhūmatsya māhiṣāja mahāmāṃsaṃ varāhāmiṣādi jvālā mālā prajvalitayadu śopeta divyātta naivedya bhakṣiṇi mama śatrun khāhi 2 p. 13b) guhyakālike naivedyaṃ samarpayāmi naivedyasya || hrīṁ hūṁ phreṁ caṇḍajvālā prajvalita mahāśmaśāna mahāśmaśāna guhyekāli jvala 2 āgacchā gaccha narta 2 tiṣṭha 2 mamaśatrun bhakṣaya 2 jvālācaṇḍa mahākā nararudhira māṃsa bhakṣiṇi naralokaṃ mahaya 2 mamābhīṣṭaṃ dehi 2 madhū matsya māṃsādyupakarpita samayācāra pūjāvali mimāmavalokayāvalokaya tubhyaṃ nivedayāmi gṛhna 2 māṃrakṣa 2 hūṁ phaṭ namaḥ svahā || p. 14a) atha puṣpāṃjaliḥ || hrīṁ hūṁ phreṁ caṇḍapracaṇḍi cara 2 uparaktāṃ kārā prajvarita karavīrādi puṣpa mālini imāṃ pūjāṃ jaliṃ gṛhna 2 masaśatrun hana 2 māṃrakṣa 2 guhyakālike hūṁ phaṭ nama svāhā || atha śaṃkhaṣṭhāpanaṃ || hrīṁ jaya śaṃkhadhyanirāvinikālike namaḥ svāhā || p. 14b) namaskāra || śrīmahāśaṃkhayoni cakreśvari śmaśāna kālike hūṁ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā || prakṣāṇaṃ || yantraṃ likhet || vindu aṣṭadala || caturasrakṣyāmvimva || huṁ phaṭ || tripādī prakṣālanaṃ || tripādi pūjā || rāṃ agnimaṇḍalāya daśa kalātmane namaḥ || śaṃkhapūjā || hrīṁ sūrya maṇḍalāya dvādaśa kalātmane namaḥ || tatradikpālaṃ pūjayet || hrīṁ hūṁ phreṁ indraguhye kāli śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ || p 15a) 3 agniguhyakālī 13 || 3 yama guhyakālī || 3 nai ṛtyaguhye kara || 3 varuṇā guhye || 3 vāyuguhye 12 || 3 kūveraguhye 12 || 3 iśāna guhye 12 || 3 vrahmaguhye 12 || 3 bhairava guhye 12 || tato jalena pūjayet || 3 amṛta jvālāmālike amṛtaṃ pūraya 2 phreṁ namasvāhā || vaṃśoma maṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśa kalātmane namaḥ || tantrayantra likhet || trikoṇa paṃcakoṇa aṣṭapatra bhūvimva || p. 15b) trikoṇe phreṁ || paṃcakoṇe laṃ vaṃ raṃ yaṃ phaṃ || aṣṭapatre aṃ kaṃ caṃ taṃ ṭaṃ paṃ yaṃ śaṃ || bhūvimva raṃ laṃ taṃ kṣaṃ paṃ yaṃ saṃ haṃ || aṃ hrīṁ phreṁ aṁ hrīṁ phreṁ vrahma guhyekālī śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ || śaṃkhamūle || oṃ hrīṁ phreṁ viṣṇu guhye kālī 10 || maṃ hrīṁ phreṁ rudra guhyekālī 10 || śakhāgre pūjayet || abhimantrayet || hrīṁ śrīṁ phreṁ amṛte amṛtayogīni kālike jvara 2 śrīṃ namaḥ svāhā || śaṃkha || dhenumudrā yonimudrāṃ darśana || p. 16a) iti śaṃkha sthāpanaṃ || atha śrīpātra sthāpanaṃ || hrīṁ śrīṁ klīṁ śaktigaṇapatinātha śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ || hrīṁ śrīṁ klīṁ gurupādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ || iti yonimudrayā namaskṛtya | phreṁ śmaśānakālyai nama || yonimudrayā devī namaskṛtya || hrīṁ kāli 2 hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā || iti tripādīkṣālanaṃ || vindutrikoṇa aṣṭadalabhūvimvaṃ likhet || madhya hrīṁ likhet || p. 16b) hrīṁ śrīṁ phreṁ mahāśmaśāṇāya namaḥ || iti maṇḍalaṃ saṃpūjya namaḥ svāhā || tripādīṃ || pūjayet || hrīṁ śrīṁ phreṁ rāṃ rīṃ rūṃ raiṃ rauṃ raḥ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśa kalātmane namaḥ huṃ nama || jvalena kṣālanaṃ || aiṃ namaḥ dravyeṇakṣālanaṃ || hrīṁ namaḥ
